testcase.name: Scenario: Choose and restore annotation scale for an active view: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:965:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Choose and restore annotation scale for an active view ✔ Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a copied view representation is active ✔ And its annotation scale is Auto ✔ When the user opens the active view's context menu and expands Annotation Scale ✔ Then Auto is checked ✔ And fixed ratios and Custom are available ✔ When the user chooses 1:1 ✔ And the user reopens the Annotation Scale submenu ✔ Then 1:1 is checked ✔ And Auto is not checked ✔ When the user chooses Auto ✔ And the user reopens the Annotation Scale submenu ✔ Then Auto is checked ✔ And 1:1 is not checked ✔ When the user dismisses the menus ✔ Then the copied view remains active ✔ And the viewport remains empty

testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a custom annotation scale: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:985:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a custom annotation scale ✔ Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a copied view representation is active with annotation scale Auto ✔ When the user opens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu ✔ And the user chooses Custom ✔ Then the Edit Annotation Scale dialog opens with Auto selected ✔ And OK is disabled ✔ When the user replaces the scale with "3:2" ✔ Then the scale field displays "3:2" ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user cancels the dialog ✔ And the user reopens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu ✔ Then Auto is checked ✔ When the user dismisses the menus ✔ Then the copied view remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Accept a custom annotation scale: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1003:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Accept a custom annotation scale ✔ Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a copied view representation is active with annotation scale Auto ✔ When the user opens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu ✔ And the user chooses Custom ✔ And the user replaces the scale with "3:2" ✔ And the user confirms the dialog ✔ And the user reopens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu ✔ Then Custom is checked ✔ And the Custom entry displays the equivalent decimal value 1.50 ✔ When the user selects Auto ✔ Then the annotation scale submenu closes
